name: custom/guide-description
title: Guide Description
description: Displays ONLY a Guide's Description text, pulled live from wherever it's entered in wp-admin — nothing else (not the chapter list; see custom/guide-single for that). Split out 2026-08-16 so the description can be placed independently anywhere on the page, instead of being fixed to wherever custom/guide-single itself sits. No picker/attributes — the site has exactly one Guide (see guide-cpt.php), so this always shows that one automatically.
